description: Vectorised permutation test for the IF ionic repeat and summary figure of KRT9 coiled-coil signatures
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

seq = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P35527.json",timeout=60).json()["sequence"]["value"]
S = {"coil 1A":seq[152:188], "coil 1B":seq[207:299], "coil 2":seq[322:461],
     "head":seq[:152], "tail":seq[465:]}
rod = seq[152:465]
KD = dict(zip("AVLIPFMWGSTCYNQDEKRH",
      [1.8,4.2,3.8,4.5,-1.6,2.8,1.9,-0.9,-0.4,-0.8,-0.7,2.5,-1.3,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.9,-4.5,-3.2]))
CHG = dict(zip("DEKR",[-1,-1,1,1]))

def Pmat(X, periods):
    """X: (k, n) matrix of mean-centred signals -> (k, len(periods)) power"""
    n = X.shape[1]; t = np.arange(n)
    W = 2*np.pi/periods[:,None] * t[None,:]          # (p, n)
    C = X @ np.cos(W).T; Sn = X @ np.sin(W).T        # (k, p)
    return (C**2 + Sn**2)/n

per_h = np.arange(2.5, 6.0, 0.01)
per_c = np.arange(6.0, 14.0, 0.01)

# charge periodicity permutation test, vectorised
x = np.array([CHG.get(c,0.0) for c in rod]); x -= x.mean()
obs = Pmat(x[None,:], per_c).max()
rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
perm = np.array([rng.permutation(x) for _ in range(3000)])
nullmax = Pmat(perm, per_c).max(axis=1)
pk = per_c[np.argmax(Pmat(x[None,:], per_c)[0])]
print(f"Rod charge periodicity: peak at {pk:.2f} residues (theory for IF rods: 9.55)")
print(f"  observed power = {obs:.1f}; null (3000 shuffles) mean = {nullmax.mean():.1f}, sd = {nullmax.std():.1f}")
print(f"  empirical p = {(nullmax>=obs).sum()/3000:.4f}, z = {(obs-nullmax.mean())/nullmax.std():.2f}")

# figure
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15.5, 4.4))

for k,c,lw in [("coil 1A","#b03030",1.7),("coil 1B","#d4772f",1.7),("coil 2","#2f6f4e",1.7),
               ("head","#999999",1.0),("tail","#cfcfcf",1.0)]:
    v = np.array([KD.get(ch,0.0) for ch in S[k]]); v -= v.mean()
    axes[0].plot(per_h, Pmat(v[None,:], per_h)[0]/len(S[k]), color=c, lw=lw, label=k)
axes[0].axvline(3.5, ls="--", color="k", lw=0.9)
axes[0].text(3.56, axes[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.85, "3.5\n(heptad a, d)", fontsize=9)
axes[0].set_xlabel("period (residues)"); axes[0].set_ylabel("normalised power")
axes[0].set_title("Hydrophobic periodicity by segment"); axes[0].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)

v = np.array([CHG.get(ch,0.0) for ch in rod]); v -= v.mean()
axes[1].plot(per_c, Pmat(v[None,:], per_c)[0]/len(rod), color="#b03030", lw=1.8, label="rod 153-465")
vt = np.array([CHG.get(ch,0.0) for ch in S["tail"]]); vt -= vt.mean()
axes[1].plot(per_c, Pmat(vt[None,:], per_c)[0]/len(S["tail"]), color="#cfcfcf", lw=1.1, label="tail")
axes[1].axvline(9.55, ls="--", color="k", lw=0.9)
axes[1].text(9.7, axes[1].get_ylim()[1]*0.85, "9.55\n(ionic repeat)", fontsize=9)
axes[1].set_xlabel("period (residues)"); axes[1].set_ylabel("normalised power")
axes[1].set_title("Charge periodicity"); axes[1].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)

names=["coil 1A","coil 1B","coil 2","head","tail"]
ad=[81.8,70.4,60.0,34.1,15.6]; oth=[16.0,23.1,23.2,17.6,6.2]
x2=np.arange(5); w=0.36
axes[2].bar(x2-w/2, ad, w, color="#b03030", label="heptad a and d positions")
axes[2].bar(x2+w/2, oth, w, color="#bbbbbb", label="all other positions")
for i,(p_) in enumerate(["3e-4","3e-5","6e-5","0.033","0.12"]):
    axes[2].text(x2[i], max(ad[i],oth[i])+2.5, "p="+p_, ha="center", fontsize=8)
axes[2].set_xticks(x2); axes[2].set_xticklabels(names, rotation=15, fontsize=9)
axes[2].set_ylabel("percent hydrophobic residues"); axes[2].set_ylim(0,95)
axes[2].set_title("Hydrophobic seam at the coiled-coil interface")
axes[2].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
